content:
计算二重积分时，固定 \(x\)，内层对 \(y\) 积分：

\[
f(x^2-y)\neq 0 \iff -1\le x^2-y\le 2
\]

因此

\[
x^2-2\le y\le x^2+1
\]

此时

\[
\int_{x^2-2}^{x^2+1} (x^2-y)\,dy
= \int_{-1}^{2} u\,du
= \frac32
\]

又因为 \(f(x)\neq 0\) 仅当 \(-1\le x\le 2\)，所以

\[
\iint_D f(x)f(x^2-y)\,d\sigma
= \frac32 \int_{-1}^{2} x\,dx
= \frac32\cdot \frac32
= \frac94
\]

答案：A
